lines.game.karaoke.pushed: You're screaming. Not the words. The words left a while ago. Just screaming, on the beat, more or less, at a bar in Kenton.
lines.game.karaoke.held: You scream the quiet part too.
lines.inspiration.struck: AN IDEA. A dog two streets over starts barking back.
lines.inspiration.expired: IT'S GONE. WHERE DID IT GO. Somebody closes a window.
lines.scavenge.found: You find {item}, loudly. A man across the way looks up, decides it isn't about him, and walks faster.
lines.item.used: You finish the {item}. Your knee is going like a sewing machine. It would like another.
lines.making.started: You start, all at once, everywhere on it, at a speed that alarms the materials.
lines.piece.artist.solid: Done: {work}. IT'S GOOD. You've told it so several times.
lines.piece.artist.rough: Done: {work}. You did it very fast. You can tell. Anyone could tell. IT'S FINE.
lines.location.return: BACK AT {place}! AGAIN! NOBODY TOLD YOU IT WOULD BE THE SAME!
lines.perception.misfire: THAT'S NOT HERE! THIS IS {place}! WHO MOVED IT!
